execution: Unmodified PostgreSQL-target SQL, executed locally with SQLite
compiled_sql: SELECT SUM(orders.amount - COALESCE(orders.refund_amount, 0)) AS legacy_net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN orders.order_date < '2026-11-01' OR orders.is_employee = 0 THEN orders.amount - COALESCE(orders.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS current_net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN orders.is_employee = 0 THEN orders.amount - COALESCE(orders.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS restated_net_sales FROM main.orders AS orders WHERE orders.order_date >= '2026-10-01' AND orders.order_date < '2027-01-01'

checks.case: Employee orders before and on the effective date
Missing refund counts as zero for an included order
Exclusive quarter end removes the January order

limitations: No live Studio, Agent, Hub or warehouse integration test.
